quest.title: The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!
quest.description: As summer comes into its own, you receive a mysterious letter. "To Whomsoever Finds This Letter" — the sender seems to be waiting for someone...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Go to the Adventurers' Guild in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler. It so happens that a friend of yours asked me to pass on a voice message when I saw you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone left a message for us? Who could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: "My beloved retainer, have you noticed that silver thread, of which fate is woven, now twisting and twining itself around you? The Auge der Verurteilung des... hmm? Des... Großen Kaleidophantasmas... will be watching you..."

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Apologies, this message is unusually difficult to recite. Would you like to hear more?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... definitely sounds like Fischl's note... What should we do?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: "...will be watching you as you step into the glorious castle of the Immernachtreich. Come to me at once, swear an oath to me in my blessed name, and we shall journey together to the depths of the world."

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Anyway, to summarize — Miss Fischl asked me to ask you to go to the plaza in front of the Cathedral.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Please meet her there when you have the time. She said that she will be waiting for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Fischl... such a mystifying message for such a plain and simple request...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if Fischl's expecting us, then let's not keep her waiting. Let's head towards the Cathedral plaza!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There she is! And Mona, too!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oh, welcome, welcome, most loyal attendants of the Prinzessin!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Which one is it, "retainer" or "attendant"? Make up your mind...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: My apologies. Mein Fräulein tends to use exaggerated expressions when she's in good spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Fischl! You were looking for us, right? Sounds like the fun's started without us! What's got you in such a good mood?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice to see you all again, it's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: And so, the whisper of eternal night summons you back to my side. Splendid! What a blessed reunion, a boon from beyond the eventide! Come, partake of this joy with me, my subjects...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, it's a pleasure to see you again. Mein Fräulein and I extend to you our most sincere greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to say a proper hello too, but Paimon has no idea how to, uh... partake...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: A normal person in this situation would simply say: "Hi Traveler, how have you been?"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: #Hmph! {NICKNAME} and I are like intertwined stars in the vast galaxy. You of all people should very well know the fate foretold by this meeting!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Precisely! Lady Megistus, please refrain from such unimaginative utterances.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Lady M—Meg...? What now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that your new nickname?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hehe, Lady Megistus has long since become a citizen of the Immernachtreich. She has been serving as Court Archmage under one's command for some time now.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ahem! That's just my surname, don't mind that... This is so embarrassing, hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're here because Fischl asked Katheryne to ask you to come, right?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Indeed so, my Archmage. Did even this appear in thy divination? Why, your powers are truly dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh for the love of... No, of course not! You told me yourself that you'd left a message with Katheryne!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ahem! Excuse me... Anyway, in my case she practically beat the door down to get me to come along... Whatever she says, please don't be too astonished.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, don't worry. We've been around the block, you can't faze us!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oh, faithful servants! One's homeland, the Immernachtreich, which bears the darkest of all fates, draws near to this world once more. Stand with me in anticipation, for the glory of our kingdom is nigh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what...?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Indeed! Only one's most faithful envoys are fortunate enough to be privy to this great revelation. The Immernachtreich is near Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll report this to the Knights of Favonius immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: No, please, that will be most unnecessary!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I know it sounds absurd, but there's actually something behind this, I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Basically, what Fischl means is—

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Lady Megistus!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Urgh, alright, alright! Honestly... Look at me, a genius astrologist, forced into a juvenile role-playing game...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The truth is that yesterday, Her Highness encountered the Spark Knight, Klee outside of the city. Both being of great fame, they recognized one another instantly, and began to converse.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: It was already getting dark, so in that spirit of great compassion and care for which she is known, Her Highness personally accompanied Klee back to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: On the way, Her Highness relayed to Klee the story of her origins. Upon hearing the tragic tale of the fall of Her Highness's homeworld, the tender-hearted Spark Knight inquired, with tears welling up in her eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: "Oh no! Is the Immernachtreich really gone? Won't it grow back?"

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: "O mortal, your sovereign's heart is touched by thy sincerity and sympathy. But nay, the Immernachtreich is an everlasting realm, and one day, it shall make its reappearance."

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: "Really? So how do we make your homeland grow back again? Oh, pwease tell me, pweeease, pweeeeease!"

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: "Since you inquire so earnestly... give unto me a tranquil haven, promise me eternal admiration, lend me both time and wind, and one shall revive one's homeworld."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could you cut the re-enactment and just get to the point!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: In short, Klee gave Fischl an island to serve as the promised land where the Immernachtreich will reappear. I didn't believe it either at first, but then I saw this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Providence has gifted mein Fräulein with an excellent opportunity. Esteemed Traveler, as mein Fräulein's cherished retainer, you deserve to bear witness to this grand moment with us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This island looks kinda familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um...ahh...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Traveler! Curtail thy umming and ahhing at once! The throne of the Immernachtreich calls for me. Come, be my blade, clear the way, and witness what is to come!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I think she just wants to invite you along to the island with her. That being said, I have a feeling that I'll be better off not performing any divination where that island's concerned...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why not?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Klee is involved in this, which means her mother is probably involved, which means that old hag is involved... Ugh, thanks, but no thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can I do for you, Your Highness?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: You, who have traveled to the farthest reaches of the world, fathomed the celestial path of stardust in the palm of your hand, and witnessed raindrops converge and become one with the undercurrent of destiny... You, yes, you...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: ...Must chart the course that leads the way to the land promised to mein Fräulein by fate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh. Fischl doesn't know the way there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I knew it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe, since thou askethed for our help, Paimon can telleth you that we are good friends with the Spark Knight, Klee: The Guides of Destiny!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, seriously...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, come on, just play along!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very well! I am the one whomst hath traveled here from beyond the stars!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #Behold, the watcher, the guide, the weaver of dreams... {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Excellent, most excellent!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A crowd of bemused Mondstadters watches on as this spectacle continues for another half hour...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...To sum up, Traveler, since you say you know the way, we'll let you take us to the island— I mean, the promised land.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Good, fine, done. Right, now — Lady Megistus needs to go home to pack her things and catch up on some sleep. Your Highness, your other distinguished selves, let's meet at the city gate at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Very well! Then it is settled. One blesses you with an undisturbed slumber, Lady Megistus. You too, Traveler.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein means to say: "Good night, see you all tomorrow."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: About darn time... good night!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon's exhausted! You all have proper roles! How come Paimon has to be a clock on the wall in the royal palace!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Cuckoo! It's twelve o'clock sharp in the Immernachtreich!"

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Paimon, you're the one who started it...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph. Anyway, since those islands are a pretty mind-blowing place, why don't we get some people with mind-boggling ideas to help us out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya's mind works in mysterious ways, but no one in Mondstadt has ideas that boggle the mind quite like...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...a certain somebody who's definitely going to be in the tavern at this hour. C'mon, let's go rope him into helping us!

choices.text: Lady Megistus, leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here! Tone-Deaf Bard! ...Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what are they doing in Mondstadt!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well look at that, you're really here! Come on, take a seat and join our delightful conversation!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #Wow, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Speak of the devil, we were literally just talking about you!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Haha, truly a curious coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kazuha, Xinyan, what are you doing here in a Mondstadt tavern? And how'd you end up having to share a table with the Tone-Deaf Bard...?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: "Tone-Deaf Bard"? Hahaha! Now that's a fun stage name. Seems like you're a pretty well-known singer, fella.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though sadly not a rock 'n' roll singer, or we could perform a duet.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So, you all know each other! My new-found friends are my old friends' friends from afar... Ah, how fantastic.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: This is a rare opportunity indeed. Oh, we should form a poetry club and call it... the "Free Poets Society," or something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You guys came here from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yeah, I felt like getting out and finding some new inspiration for my songwriting. Kazuha felt like going on a trip too, so we figured we'd travel together.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Last month, Beidou held a big booze-fueled party called the "Drink-Till-You-Sink Champion-Ship," and she put me in charge of the music. That's where I met Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Although Xinyan can come across as unruly at times, her musical understanding is highly nuanced and original. Safe to say, our shared appreciation for music struck a chord in us both.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You can say that again! In Kazuha's hands, even a leaf becomes an instrument! That makes him an expert among my friends.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Startin' from Liyue, we passed through Stone Gate and kept going till we came into Mondstadt. Then, along the way, we saw this really awesome manor, it was something else!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Yeah, we know the one. Our friend owns that place.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Really? Y'all sure have a lot of friends! Well, whoever it is that lives in that fine place must really be lovin' life, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... guess so, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Similar souls tend to attract each other. {NICKNAME} and Paimon, you must have exceptional taste, just like that friend of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you're too nice! Unlike some people who only ever seem to poke fun at Paimon, ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: By the way, do you know anything about the "Iridescence Tour"? It's supposed to be huge. Rumor has it that all seven nations of Teyvat are gonna be involved.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well, so far it's mostly just empty promises. Anyway, it's supposed to be a music festival. The organizer really did a number on me last time. They canceled on me. But I hear that they're still active.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I'd love to give the festival another shot, but wouldn't you know it — the plans fell through again... How can they mess up this bad twice in a row?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Music is all about inspiration. Maybe the organizers canceled the show because theirs dried up.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But fear not, weary travelers, for your journey was not in vain. It has, after all, brought you here, to me, to the temple of music.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Your temple of music must have more than just good tunes — you're a bard, ain't ya? A song's gotta have a good story, or it doesn't make the cut, right?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha, exactly! Ah, you understand the meaning of being a bard so well. To express my gratitude, I will even share one of these stories with you.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hahaha, you're a funny fella. Are all bards like you?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I've met many bards during my travels, but none of them are as entertaining as you.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I'm sure it all comes down to the richness of my imagination, and by extension the poverty of theirs. And on that note, here is a fantastical tale that is sure to delight you all.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Legends tell of an emerald isle in the middle of the ocean. There, the Dodo-King and his people live a blissful existence."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "When a Dodoco is born, it dives into the water. Some learn to swim, others are carried away by the waves all the way to Mondstadt, where they befriend the children there."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "One Dodoco made a new friend in Mondstadt: the little Spark Knight. But the Dodo-King did not approve. He demanded that the little knight come to the island and prove herself to him."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "So the little knight, together with her most important friend in all the world, braved the wind and waves, finally reaching the middle of the ocean. But Dodo-King was not there. Dodo-King had lied..."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "There was no trial, by fire or interrogation. The little knight's mother, who was a mage, had built an entire summer city there as a gift to her daughter along with this message:"

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Summer is the season of love. It is the time for freedom and fun. So everyone, please sing, dance, and enjoy yourselves here."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...The end.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Strange, I was just about to ask about the island...)

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: How interesting. I now have the urge to visit that island myself... This is the thing about traveling. You can't plan ahead, better to leave when the mood takes you and go where the heart leads.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha, I'm glad you liked it. Well, there's wine on the table, and I have stories to tell... seems like fate is feeling kind today.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: #Here's to music! Come on, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Don't worry, if you don't like wine, there's juice as well.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: In that case, I'll have a glass of juice. Hmm... this one. I like the color.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Somehow, you get dragged into drinking one glass after another until... Suddenly, you notice someone is feeling very tipsy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! Kazuha!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Uh-oh, this fella's drunk... But wasn't he drinking fruit juice?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: More... please more...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oops, I think I accidentally placed some fruity cocktails out there... Ehe, my bad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously!?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Anyway, guess it's time to talk about business after all that drinking. {NICKNAME}, you came here because you need my help, I presume?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah, that's a good point... We didn't come here to drink...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Venti, come with me.

talks.objective: Talk to Venti on the second floor of the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Look where we are... Yup, I can sense that you're about to tell me something very interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Venti about the Spark Knight giving an island to Fischl, and Fischl's plans to head there...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Klee gave a special gift from her mother to an adventurer friend? She's such a kindhearted child.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: As I'm sure you've already guessed, that letter is most definitely written by Alice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, thought so...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Speaking of, guess which two people I ran into on my way to the tavern today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Master Jean? Or... Lisa?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: A mother and daughter, both with long elf ears and the most amazingly adorable personalities.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alice and Klee!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ding-ding-ding! Correct answer!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The unaging mage was taking her teeny-tiny knight on a vacation, and I happened to run into them. As a friendly greeting, the mysterious woman gave me a gift...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #She also said that if I meet any fun friends, I should share this gift with them. So now, it's yours to keep, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh! It's a bomb!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Minus the fuse — so don't worry, it's not going to explode. Come on, take it. This way, we can talk to each other just like this even when we're apart.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, that sounds impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's called a "Dodocommunication Device," and it allows people to stay in touch over vast distances. However, you can't just use it anytime you want, and there's also a limit on the number of times you can use it. That's why it's currently only available to a certain select few.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I heard that the inspiration for this comes from another world... Alice is always full of surprises.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: She and Klee asked me to tell you: "Please take this with you when you depart for the island— no wait, the promised land with your friends, and have fun!"

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Don't worry about how to get there. The organizers of this vacation have made arrangements. Turn right after you exit the city gates, and you'll see something that will make you very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like the two of you are in cahoots over this...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not. Is that really the sort of person you think I am?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're my friend. And as your friend, I just want to give you something that will make you happy. How can you think this of me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fair enough... the Tone-Deaf Bard does like to joke around, but he's still one of our best friends. Besides, a vacation sounds great, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, Kazuha and Xinyan seemed pretty interested in coming on this trip, too. Let's ask them if they wanna join us!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You're back. Poor Kazuha's still out for the count... seems like he can't handle alcohol so well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xinyan, do you wanna come to the islands with us?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: *snore*... adventure... can't...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh? He doesn't wanna go anymore? He seemed really interested just a moment ago.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Can't... miss... the adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, Kazuha might act mature, but deep down he's just another youngster eager for new experiences. That must be why he didn't think anything of the "fruit juice" earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, all the more reason for you to join the island trip! You know, a lot of people have praised the beautiful scenery there — even bards.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #Okay! Sounds like a plan! {NICKNAME}, how do we get there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone's got it covered, apparently. There'll be a few others joining us on this trip, and we're meeting at the city gate tomorrow morning. We'll wait for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kazuha, wake up! We're going wandering!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #...Hm? {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, they don't know Fischl yet, do they! Okay, so here's the deal, there's a princess from a faraway land and her retinue, who're also coming on this trip...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon, don't get me wrong, I'm just askin' to make sure... but from the way you're plugging this trip so hard... did the Iridescence Tour folks put you up to this?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: After all, canceling the Iridescence Tour after people already made the trip... That's kinda the same thing as tricking people into going traveling, ain't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh! Why won't anyone believe Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha, don't worry about that for now. You'll all have the chance to get acquainted with each other tomorrow morning.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Whether you're a princess, a retainer, a talking raven, a samurai or a musician... You're all VIP guests of the island on your summer vacation, and that's what counts, right?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I'm sure lookin' forward to it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you coming too, Venti?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'll have to pass. I have some work to take care of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You serious? The Tone-Deaf Bard actually has plans to do some work?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I promised a young lady with cat ears and a cat tail that I'd sing in her tavern to boost business and beat the competition. Ah yes, the competition being this place, which has Six-Fingered José.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aren't you allergic to cats?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yup! I can always sing on their roof.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: She told me that as long as their sales surpass their competitor, there's a whole month's worth of wine in it for me. What a fine employment opportunity, virtually tailor-made for me!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So have fun, and don't worry about me. Haha, I feel like this summer is going to be a very interesting one.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Today is the day of one's reckoning with fate, as foretold by the night sky! Humiliations suffered in the past, the shame we have carried all these years, one bids you adieu! For today, it is time for... retribution!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, if I may be so bold, that final phrase did not sound like one of your own.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Of course it wasn't. I just overheard it from someone in the city... Ahem! I mean, thy Prinzessin is merely drawing on the wisest and courageous sayings she has heard in the land, to signify the importance of this day...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me see... Huh? It really is someone else's catchphrase...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you're here early!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hi!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Who've you brought with you...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Ahem! Allow Paimon to introduce to you a fabled wandering swordsman of Inazuma, and an enchanting musical talent of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey! I'm Xinyan, from Liyue. I like rock 'n' roll, sunny days, and good times.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You must be the princess Paimon told us about? You sure do look the part! I hear you're from a faraway land — it's an honor to be in the company of dignitaries!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: And this lady over here... My family tells me that only the wisest scholars wear pointed hats like this one. Guessing that applies to you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Mona and Fischl
dialogues.text: (Oh, I like her. She can stay!)

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Xinyan, your gaze pierces the dark veil of night to arrive at the truth beyond. I am in need of one such as yourself. Very well, you shall be one's musician laureate.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: She's trying to say, thanks, you say all the right things! Um, and the same goes for me too. Pleasure to meet you. I'm Mona, an astrologist.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, well it's nice to meet you too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mona is amazing, she can find out everything about you by divination!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A princess, an astrologist, and an articulate raven-retainer... In the company of giants, my humble self hardly deserves mention.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I am Kaedehara Kazuha from Inazuma. It is an honor to meet you all.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: What ho, Kazuha, divulge thy epithets and thy vocation.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Oh, mein Fräulein would like to know where you work, and what your field of expertise is.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Um... I'm afraid I'm just another wanderer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy is an expert in the sword arts. He parries blades that none have ever parried before, and strikes like lightning! Mere mortals could not hope to comprehend!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: (What? Is he really that powerful!?)

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Let me take a look... huh!? Oh, oh my...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hi, Kazuha, I'm absolutely delighted to meet a great swordmaster like you. Could we ask you to be our guard while we're on the island?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: One hereby declares you Captain of the Royal Guard of the Immernachtreich.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: For even Lady Megistus to praise your skills, you are surely one of rare talent.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lady Megistus is absolutely right!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Okay, Lady M—Meg...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Lady M—Megi... what?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Just call me Mona! Stop calling me that weird name.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, Lady Megistus, we found out how to get to the promised land.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A legendary great mage gave us a big hint. Come on, everyone follow Paimon!

talks.objective: Go to the location Paimon mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, everyone! Here's our vehicle.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Somehow, I suddenly don't feel like going anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: What a... unique little thing. Looks kinda like Guoba, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Guoba... is he the magical creature at Wanmin Restaurant? Now that you mention it... it does look quite similar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... to be honest, even Paimon isn't so sure this can take us to the island after all...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I see... I see. Only by meeting the lowliest of ends can we arrive at the Immernachtreich born anew.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Haha, behold, the doorway cloven by Thundering Retribution... by such means as I once descended into this realm to bring retribution do I now venture into the next. Come, Oz! Lead the way!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I will enter first. Mein Fräulein need not worry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...He's in... and now he's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Why... this truly is the path of retribution that leads to the promised land!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Maybe I should just do a quick reading for safety...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lady Megistus, it's fine! This is Alice's creation, it's totally safe! Spare yourself the trouble, just come with us.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh right! I completely forgot...*sigh* Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone exchanges glances before, one by one, stepping nervously but excitedly into the "Dodofortress"...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The journey is an eventful one... and maybe a little crowded...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so dark in here. Um, can someone turn on a light? Hey! Quit pushing!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Come on now, let's all try and stay... Ow! Fischl! You're treading on my hair!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I thought it was a snake!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Ahh! We're flying!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Everyone, be careful!

talks.objective: Go to the Golden Apple Archipelago

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what's that huge weird thing over there!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It appears to be some sort of machine and an army cap with traces of Hydro next to it. It seems that we are not the first to set foot on this island.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Also, there are footprints here. Fresh ones, likely no more than a few days old.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon didn't notice them at all...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, stay alert.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why? Did you see something?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Someone was here... and they're still nearby. Judging from the scent... they are visitors here, like us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #There's other people here? Oh, Paimon's scared now...Come on, {NICKNAME}, we need to track 'em down!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Whew, we finally landed! What was that all about...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What a beautiful place. The wind is soft and the ocean is calm... And a pleasant scent blows on the breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Paimon's feeling way better already now that we can see the ocean!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: An ocean of life, and a land filled with flora... Mein Fräulein, we have finally arrived at the promised land, whence we shall revive the Immernachtreich.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...O faithful retainers, this is the blessed paradise that one has been searching for. Here is where we shall witness the culmination of all things!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I, who command the darkness, shall lead you to yonder gate of dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...shall lead you... to yonder gate of dreams!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Your Archmage Megistus thanks you for your kindness, Your Highness. In this moment, I offer my blessings to the Immernachtreich.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Mona... wh—what are you, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Don't ask, just follow my lead!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh... oh right! Praise be to the Prinzessin, who has led us here to this sacred place!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My sincere gratitude to you for inviting me to join you on this trip, Your Highness.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Your happiness gladdens one's heart. Ah... how it delights me to bring us all together here at this most monumentally fateful of moments.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Now, as I take my first step on this pilgrimage, I shall perceive this ocean of life with my own earthly vessel. After all, this is where my soul belongs.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: On the contrary, Lady Megistus, blessed as you are with the great power of Hydro, one yet finds too many impurities in thy soul... Mm-mm.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein means Lady Megistus is perhaps not the most talented swimmer.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...Fischl, that's enough!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I'm happy enough to join in with the play-acting without complaining, but how dare you ridicule my genius? Think you can swim better than me? Hah, I'll bring you to your knees, young lady!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Oh my! Mein Fräulein, steel yourself, mein Fräulein!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! Swimming race, swimming race! Whoever comes in last is a rotten egg!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Challenge accepted! Heed my words, lowly Lady Megistus, you shall pay for your foolishness for as long as you live!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ridiculous. I've never lost a single swimming race in my life. Bring it on! First one to run to the beach wins!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Are they serious? Running? I thought they were gonna swim.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Never mind, looks like they're enjoying this.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #I take it you have no present plans, {NICKNAME}? I want to start by surveying the area first. Want to come along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh Kazuha, it's good we can count on you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I saw an island in the northwest, far in the distance. It looked very distinctive. I'd like to take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Xinyan, are you coming?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seems like everyone's got things to do... I'll stay here and hold down the fort for now. Mona and Fischl have gone swimming, and someone's gotta set up camp.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I got this! You're gonna take a look around, right? Well, make sure you lemme know if there are any good views!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks! Will do!

talks.objective: Go to the island that Kazuha mentioned
Use Elemental Sight to follow the traces

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are there Fatui on this island! Isn't there a single place in this world without Mint, Sweet Flowers, and Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They get everywhere, like weeds...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Interesting observation.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: *sob* Cappy-cap's gone... where's cappy-cap...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Are you looking for something?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: A cap... I c—can't... can't lose it...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: Ah! I don't know anything... Gimme back cappy-cap... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Is this the cap you're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: My brother's cappy-cap! Gimme, gimme, gimme!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You return the cap to the Fatuus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, this guy is not the sharpest sword in the sheath...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: Don't bully me! Or I'll punch you in the... Aah! Monster, monster! *sob*
Stop right there! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Another Fatuus! We could ask you the same question! What are YOU doing here, hmm!?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: Protect... cappy-cap... or brother will get mad at me...

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: Forget the cap! It's your brother we're looking for!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What happened to him?

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: ...Nothing. He has a fever... he's just a little delirious, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: I don't have to tell you anything. Go bother someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This island belongs to our friend! You better watch what you say, mister.

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: What? I thought this island was uninhabited. That's why we came here to... Ahem, never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that machine for?

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: ...Tsk, fine. I'll tell you, but then you need to leave me alone.

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: It's a new kind of energy generator that I invented. We were simply looking for a deserted island to test it out on. There, satisfied?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like we told you, this island is ours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do not impede our vacationing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and if you don't do as you're told, we'll... Oh, we'll take his cap!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: Ah! Please don't... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: Hey, stop crying! ...Alright, I promise, we'll stay within this area. Okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, by the way, why is there smoke coming out of your machine?

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: Because the cursed thing is broken! As much as I hate to say it, our tests did not go to plan. We were getting ready to leave anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, well just see yourselves out whenever you're ready. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Persikov
dialogues.text: Come on! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Soldier
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe we have to deal with the Fatui during our vacation...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Why would the Fatui appear in such an isolated corner of the world... Whatever their reasons, it's likely more complicated than we might think.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Even though we're on vacation, we should stay vigilant, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I agree.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Also, in the interests of keeping the ladies in good spirits, I have a suggestion.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Let's keep this between us for now. Let them enjoy their vacation while {NICKNAME} and I deal with any potential threats. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Makes sense. I'm in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're so considerate, Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Paimon, you flatter me. I simply don't think it's worth ruining anyone's vacation over a trivial matter like this.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The scenery is beautiful... I hope all of us can enjoy ourselves here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #Just in time! So {NICKNAME}, Paimon, who do you think the real swimming champion is? Me or Fischl?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Haha! Utter my supreme name, and see how Lady Megistus the presumptuous is reduced to bitter tears!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'll go with whoever Paimon says is the winner.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no you don't! Don't put this on Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Oh wise Paimon, surely you can discern who the true winner is.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Lady Paimon, the time to show your loyalty is nigh.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wait, wait wait wait! Shouldn't Paimon get some food in her first? Poor thing looks starvin' after such a long trek out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh! Thank you, Xinyan!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, we did walk quite a long way.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Right? While you were off doing your own things, I caught us some seafood and picked us a few fruits. They taste real good barbecued!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I'm getting a little peckish myself...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ahem! I, too...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well there's plenty to go around, so dig in! I can't say I've got the culinary skills of my chef friend, but I promise you'll at least eat your fill!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Time to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Inviting Lady Xinyan here was an astute decision indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's done talking, you guys carry on if you wanna go hungry!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, I love that barbecue smell... This tastes amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Mmm! Impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Since Xinyan made dinner for us, allow me to take charge of breakfast tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great! Looking forward to it already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, you forgot about something!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, let's talk over there.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kazuha, Kazuha! ...Ugh, he just won't wake up! Looks like we're staying in the tavern tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: zzz... zzz...

talks.objective: Contact Venti in a less conspicuous place

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That whole thing with the Fatui is bothering you, too, right? Well, remember the bomb thing that Venti gave us? We can contact him using that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, no, not a bomb. Venti said it's called a "Dodocommunication Device"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's ask Venti if he knows anything. He always seems clued-in on everything, so if there's any intel floating around, he'll definitely know about it!

dialogues.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
dialogues.text: Dodo! Dodo! Dodoco!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Achoo! Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Heya! Miss me already, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hi Venti, it's me.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, I know that. You're the only person who can contact me on this thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come you're sneezing?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm at The Cat's Tail... so many cats... They gave me some allergy medicine, but it's not working... Achoo! Okay, go on then, what are you calling about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, tell him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could you be any lazier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, well Venti, there's some strange things going on on this island... We ran into the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The Fatui... yeah, they're everywhere, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahaha, the Cryo Archon's minions are a capable crew. I'd be more surprised if they hadn't shown up yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But they're ruining our vacation!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Really? But... you sound fine, they can't have caused you too much trouble, surely? Or if they did, I'm sure you have everything under control by now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but something just doesn't feel right, that's why we came to you... Don't you have any information for us?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I haven't heard anything new about the Fatui. But don't worry. I may be a lowly tone-deaf bard, but you may contact me whenever you need me.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I mean, I can't promise I'll be of much help, but at least you'll have someone to talk to, right? Sometimes, just talking things through is enough to calm a worried mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Adventuring is what you do best. It's only natural to encounter a few surprises when you head somewhere new, but just remember, not all unexpected encounters are dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The same wind graces the seaside as that which wafts over pastures green. Wherever you see clouds, it was the wind that carried them there. Don't worry, my friends, the wind will always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Okay then, I have to go now — my performance in the Cat's Tail is starting any second!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, bye!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he means we don't need to worry too much about the Fatui, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if that's what the Tone-Deaf Bard says... then fingers crossed we'll have a peaceful and relaxing vacation where nothing weird happens at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When you go off on a long trip with your friends, the important thing is to have fun!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll start by catching ten crabs and twenty fish! Hmm... will that be enough for all of us? Maybe I should prepare something else?

dialogues.speaker: Swimming Race That Must Have A Result Today
dialogues.text: Archmage Megistus Versus Fischl the Prinzessin der Verurteilung

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said the cap had traces of Hydro on it? Then let's follow the traces of elemental energy!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: We're close. Watch out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's the Fatui!
